neighbours.label: The first half of a binomial pair, right before an expected 'and' ('hot and humid', 'time and money', 'heat and pressure'): the - pole promotes ' and'; the same word on its own stays under it
fire: The weather here is hot and humid all year.
It takes time and money to fix the roof.
Intense heat and pressure formed the diamonds.
The winter was cold and wet in the north.
We thank you for your time and energy.
The air was warm and still at dusk.
Hard work and patience will get you there.
The project needed time and effort from all of us.

We thank you for your energy.

short: first half of a binomial, before 'and'
notes: Card: ' time' x6, ' work' x3, ' years' x2, ' warm', ' heat', ' hot'. Logit effect of the + pole suppresses ' and', ' и', ' &', 'and', 和, so the - pole promotes them. Probe: 'hot and stormy' 0.55, 'heat and pressure' 0.37, 'time and effort' 0.29, 'time, patience' 0.23, 'time and cost' 0.15; plain alternatives at most 0.10. The activation reads the context before the 'and', so the near misses drop the pair entirely.
